description: This Java class provides utility methods for retrieving nullable values from JDBC ResultSet objects, delegating to Spring's JdbcUtils where applicable. It handles various data types including date/time, numeric, and BigDecimal, with special handling for default null or zero values.

classes.name: JdbcSupport
classes.description: Final utility class for safely retrieving nullable and defaulted values from JDBC ResultSet objects.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a ZonedDateTime from a ResultSet column, considering tenant timezone.

methods.name: getLocalDate
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalDate from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getLocalTime
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalTime from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getIntegerDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer, returning null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getLongDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves a Long, returning null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getBigDecimalDefaultToZeroIfNull
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getBigDecimalDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal, returning null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves an OffsetDateTime from a ResultSet column, adjusting for system and tenant time zones.
